lessons.title: be 動詞 am / is / are
lessons.en: The verb be: am / is / are

intro.p:
I → am；he / she / it / 單數名詞 → is；you / we / they / 複數名詞 → are。
be 動詞用嚟講身份、年齡、感覺、喺邊度。
ex: My sister is ten years old.

intro.p: 口語好常用：I'm, you're, he's, she's, it's, we're, they're。

否定：be + not（isn't / aren't；I'm not）。
問句：將 be 搬去句頭：Are you tired? Is he your brother?
⚠️ 冇 amn't，要講 I'm not。

中文「佢好高」冇「係」，但英文一定要有 be：
✅ He is tall.　❌ He tall.
✅ I am hungry.　❌ I hungry.

ex.why: eyes 係複數，用 are。
I 永遠配 am；講歲數用 be，唔用 have。
my grandmother 係第三人稱單數，用 is。
問句將 be 搬去句頭；your brother 係單數，用 Is。
they 用 are。
否定：I am not + 形容詞。
my parents 係複數（兩個人），用 are。

lessons.title: 一般現在式

intro.p: 講習慣、日常作息、事實。常見字眼：every day, always, usually, often, sometimes, never, on Mondays。
ex: I wake up at seven every day.
The sun rises in the east.

intro.p:
I / you / we / they + 動詞原形；he / she / it + 動詞加 -s / -es。
一般加 -s：play → plays；-sh / -ch / -o / -x 加 -es：brush → brushes，go → goes，watch → watches；輔音 + y → -ies：study → studies；have → has。
ex: She brushes her teeth after breakfast.
My brother has lunch at school.

intro.p:
否定：I / you / we / they don't + 原形；he / she / it doesn't + 原形。
問句：Do you…? / Does she…?
⚠️ 用咗 does，動詞唔再加 -s：✅ Does he like tea?　❌ Does he likes tea?
ex: Does your cat sleep all day?

intro.p:
放喺普通動詞前面、be 動詞後面：
I always get up early.　She is never late.

ex.q: My dad ___ to work by MTR every day.
ex.zh: 我爸爸每日搭港鐵返工。
ex.why: every day = 習慣，用一般現在式；my dad 係第三人稱單數，go 要加 -es。
usually = 習慣；have 嘅第三人稱單數係 has。

ex.q: My brother ___ his teeth twice a day.
ex.why: -sh 結尾加 -es：brushes。
your sister 係第三人稱單數，問句用 Does + 原形。

ex.q: We ___ eat breakfast at home. (do 嘅否定)
ex.why: we 否定用 don't + 原形。

ex.q: My cat ___ sleeps on my bed.
ex.zh: 我隻貓通常瞓喺我張床度。
ex.why: 頻率副詞放喺普通動詞前面：usually sleeps。

ex.a: She takes a shower every night
ex.why: she 用 takes（加 -s）；every night 表示習慣。

lessons.title: 名詞眾數 + a / an
lessons.reuse: a / an section adapted from old grammar.js #3

intro.h: 一個：a 定 an？睇讀音
intro.p:
a + 輔音「音」：a cup, a waiter, a uniform（讀 /juː/）。
an + 元音「音」：an egg, an orange, an hour（h 唔發音）。
ex: We wear a uniform at school.

intro.p: cup → cups；sandwich → sandwiches（-ch / -sh / -s / -x 加 -es）；tomato → tomatoes；輔音 + y → -ies：baby → babies；-f / -fe → -ves：shelf → shelves，scarf → scarves。

child → children　man → men　woman → women　tooth → teeth　foot → feet　mouse → mice
單複數一樣：fish, sheep, goldfish
ex: I brush my teeth every morning.
There are three children in the park.

intro.p:
clothes, trousers, jeans, shorts, glasses 一定用複數：
✅ My jeans are blue.　❌ My jeans is blue.
想講「一條」：a pair of jeans。

ex.zh: 唔該我要一份蛋三文治。
ex.why: egg 以元音音 /e/ 開頭，用 an。
uniform 讀 /ˈjuːnɪfɔːm/，以輔音音 /j/ 開頭，用 a。
child 嘅複數唔規則：children。
-ch 結尾加 -es：sandwiches。
tooth → teeth（唔規則）。
jeans 永遠係複數，用 are。

ex.a: I want two iced lemon teas
ex.why: 兩杯 → teas（加 -s）；叫嘢飲時可以用杯數去數 tea。

lessons.title: 可數／不可數名詞 + some / any
lessons.reuse: old grammar.js #3 — reused, examples switched to Season 1 words

intro.p:
可數名詞可以數：an apple, two apples。
不可數名詞唔可以直接數、冇複數：water, milk, rice, bread, sugar, hair, money, advice, information。
ex: There is some rice in the bowl.

intro.p: a glass of water　a bowl of rice　a slice of bread　a cup of tea　a piece of cake
ex: Can I have a glass of water?

intro.p:
some 用喺肯定句；any 用喺否定句同問句。
請人食嘢、提出要求嘅問句都用 some：Would you like some tea?

❌ breads, rices, hairs, advices, homeworks
✅ some bread, some rice, some advice

ex.zh: 你可唔可以俾啲意見我？
ex.why: advice 係不可數名詞，冇 -s、唔用 a / an。
否定句用 any；milk 不可數，唔用 a / an。
請人食嘢／飲嘢嘅問句用 some。

ex.q: Can I have a ___ of rice, please?
ex.why: 飯用碗裝：a bowl of rice。

ex.q: Is there ___ sugar in my tea? (some / any)
ex.why: 一般問句用 any；sugar 不可數。
一般問句用 any；questions 可數，用複數。
hair 係不可數名詞，當單數用 is。

lessons.title: 現在進行式

intro.h: 結構：am / is / are + 動詞-ing
intro.p: 講而家進行緊嘅事。常見字眼：now, right now, at the moment, Look!, Listen!
一般加 -ing：rain → raining；e 結尾去 e：make → making，smile → smiling；短元音 + 單輔音要雙寫：run → running，sit → sitting，swim → swimming。
ex: The kids are swimming in the sea.

intro.h: 一般現在式 vs 現在進行式
intro.p:
習慣 → 一般現在式：I usually walk to school.
而家 → 現在進行式：I am taking a taxi now.

like, know, want, need 呢類「狀態動詞」通常唔用進行式。
✅ I want tea.　❌ I am wanting tea.

ex.why: Look! 表示而家發生緊，用現在進行式；the bus 係單數，用 is。
BB 而家瞓緊 → is + sleeping。
know 係狀態動詞，唔用進行式；主語 I 用原形。
now + doing → 現在進行式；主語 you 用 are。
now → is + raining。

ex.q: The kids are ___ in the sea.
ex.why: 短元音 + 單輔音：swim → swimming（雙寫 m）。
而家進行緊：We are + having。

lessons.title: 代名詞同物主 I / me / my / mine

intro.p:
主格（做嘢嗰個）：I, you, he, she, it, we, they
受格（被做嗰個）：me, you, him, her, it, us, them
物主形容詞（+ 名詞）：my, your, his, her, its, our, their
物主代名詞（唔使名詞）：mine, yours, his, hers, ours, theirs

動詞前面用主格；動詞或者介詞後面用受格：
I love him. He loves me.
✅ Give it to me.　❌ Give it to I.

my 後面要跟名詞：This is my bag.
mine 自己成立：This bag is mine.
⚠️ its（佢嘅）冇 apostrophe；it's = it is。
ex: The cat is licking its tail.

intro.h: ⚠️ 香港人常犯：he 定 she？
intro.p: 廣東話「佢」唔分男女，英文要分：男仔 he / him / his；女仔 she / her / hers；動物同嘢 it / its。
ex: My sister is shy. She doesn't talk much.
我妹妹好怕醜，佢唔多講嘢。

ex.why: 介詞 about 後面用受格 me。

ex.q: ___ is my best friend. Her name is Amy.
ex.zh: 佢係我最好嘅朋友，佢叫 Amy。
ex.why: 女仔做主語用 She；Her name 嘅 Her 係物主形容詞。

ex.q: This bag isn't yours. It's ___. (我嘅)
ex.zh: 呢個袋唔係你嘅，係我嘅。
ex.why: 後面冇名詞嘅「我嘅」用 mine。
動物用 its（冇 apostrophe）；it's = it is。

ex.q: Tom and I are cousins. ___ are the same age.
ex.zh: Tom 同我係表兄弟，我哋同年。
ex.why: Tom and I = we，做主語用 We。

ex.q: I miss my grandparents. I often call ___. (佢哋)
ex.zh: 我好掛住爺爺嫲嫲，成日打電話俾佢哋。
ex.why: 動詞 call 後面用受格 them。

ex.zh: 佢好愛佢隻貓。（佢係女仔）
ex.why: 女仔：She + loves（加 -s）+ her cat。
